status: Private QtCore parser/selection/descriptive-statistics core actually built and tested; not SQL, page or clinical completion

binding.input_meaning: Anonymous vectors and result_val text embedded in exact executed tests.cpp; no runtime database input

api_limits: Pure value core has no SQL/catalog/dataset authentication or QWidget/worker/page integration.
Only Original/Calibration/Rate/INR; malformed/missing/non-finite values are explicit invalid rather than zero.
Current/previous batch isolation and per-batch date DESC preserved; time/id DESC tie-breakers are documented additions. Legacy reverse trace remains separately named.

Association-only/current catalog units do not prove per-point history units. Unknown/mixed units make aggregation unavailable; caller must provide authentic per-row evidence from one verified dataset.
CV is signed ratio-not-percent. No automatic normal/warning/out-of-control status, real instrument, import/manual point UI or clinical efficacy.
next_scope: Root separately schedules worker read-only replies and original chart/trace/summary integration after current frozen diagnostics; pending drafts stay in temp.
archive_policy: Only exact sources, commands, raw logs/exits/results/verification and SHA manifest; no build binary/object/Makefile, runtime database, INI, secret or production data copied.
